about.heading: About
paragraphs: I’m Brandon, born and raised in Monterey, CA. I enjoy taking complicated systems apart, understanding how they work, and finding ways to make them safer.

I started out building software, but cybersecurity became the part I cared about most: protecting the technology people rely on every day. These days, I build internal security tools at Disney and spend my free time experimenting with new ideas.
My aim is simple: make technology safer and more reliable, and raise digital literacy along the way.
